composition: A strict, evenly spaced modular grid. Small left-aligned title; generous white gutters; one restrained cobalt accent; no enclosing decorative frames.
annual: Twelve equally sized month grids in chronological 3 × 4 portrait or 4 × 3 landscape order, with one compact legend below the complete grid.
monthly: One dominant seven-column month grid. A narrow strip below provides three priorities and a short notes line; every date cell keeps a clear writing area.
weekly_shift: An uninterrupted roster: people or roles down the left, Monday–Sunday across the top, editable shift codes within cells, totals at the right, legend below.
blank: An empty seven-column, six-row month skeleton or the chosen empty weekly/time grid. Heading, month and year fields stay writable; no dates or holidays are silently filled.

composition: A linear ledger with a strong chronological axis, slim month/day labels, alternating rule weights and small sage highlights. Time is read along rows rather than within boxed mini-calendars.
annual: Twelve horizontal month rows, each containing positions 1–31 with weekday markers. Nonexistent dates are disabled visibly and never presented as dates. Landscape is preferred.
monthly: Weeks appear as full-width horizontal bands with the date and a writable line for each day; a side ruler carries ISO week numbers.
weekly_shift: Seven horizontal daily lanes with start/end fields and a continuous time axis. Multiple shifts use labelled sublanes; overnight shifts show the next-day boundary explicitly.
blank: An undated timeline with blank day/date labels and empty time or task lanes. Do not substitute a dated annual overview.

composition: Two open typographic columns separated by a single rule. Black ink on white establishes the hierarchy; restrained functional gray is allowed where it improves usability. Dates, content and writing lines use indentation rather than tinted boxes.
annual: Two columns of six months in portrait, with one consistent reading order and thin horizontal separators. If small formats fail legibility, use two complete six-month pages.
monthly: Main month grid in the wider column and a long lined notes column; week rows align with corresponding note groups.
weekly_shift: Left block contains the complete seven-day roster; the right block contains explicit coverage gaps, handover and totals. Split onto another page before compressing staff rows.
blank: A blank date/time grid plus an equal-height lined planning column, both genuinely undated and editable.

composition: A magazine-like serif masthead, main calendar body and distinct narrow marginal column. Warm ivory accents, dark ink, editorial folios and small caps provide hierarchy.
annual: Four stacked quarter sections, each with three mini-months and a marginal quarter summary. Continuous left-to-right, top-to-bottom order is mandatory.
monthly: An expansive calendar grid with a true marginal notes column, a large month numeral and one short rule separating period facts from writable notes.
weekly_shift: A formal seven-day shift table in the main column; the margin carries team details, shift key and manager notes. Keep individual hours and breaks explicit.
blank: An empty weekly/monthly working grid with blank heading lines and marginal notes; no fabricated quote, date or holiday.

composition: A restrained double-line outer frame, generous inset white space, centered title and individual captioned panels. Burgundy and warm-neutral accents remain outside writing cells.
annual: A centered 4 × 3 array of individually framed months, with quarter captions and generous separation from the outer frame.
monthly: One centered framed month; notes and important dates occupy clearly separated caption panels below the calendar.
weekly_shift: The seven-day roster is the central framed object. Shift legend and weekly totals use two balanced panels beneath it, with no decorative lines crossing entries.
blank: A framed empty grid with a title/date inscription line and independent bottom notes panel.

composition: Monochrome typographic hierarchy: large period numerals, serif headings, small sans-serif labels, strong horizontal rules, no colored accents; restrained gray rules or functional panels are permitted.
annual: Two half-year sections. Each section has a large half-year marker and six month blocks arranged 3 × 2; a broad white gap separates the halves.
monthly: Large month numeral occupies a fixed left title block; the seven-column grid starts below it, followed by aligned short task lists.
weekly_shift: The week number and period range anchor a wide header; a seven-day staff matrix sits below, with black-rule separation and labelled totals.
blank: A large blank title/date block and an empty structured worksheet. Labels describe what to write without inserting a current year.

composition: Original or appropriately licensed vector botanical sprigs form an asymmetric outer margin. The calendar itself remains white, regular and unobstructed; restrained leaf-green and terracotta accents.
annual: Twelve month panels occupy a regular grid to the right of a botanical margin; seasonal labels appear only in the margin, with chronological ordering preserved.
monthly: A full writable month grid is balanced by a narrow botanical sidebar and a short seasonal notes field outside date cells.
weekly_shift: The complete seven-day shift grid uses the full functional center. A slim botanical edge and separate legend panel provide the style without replacing schedule fields.
blank: An empty functional calendar or schedule grid with botanical art only in margins; date boxes remain blank and white.

composition: A shallow original vector alpine panorama anchors the top. Broad horizontal sections and small contour-line separators organize the page in muted blue/green; no claim to a specific landscape unless identified correctly.
annual: Four horizontal quarter bands with three month grids in each band; the panorama stays within the title band and does not reduce date labels below minimum size.
monthly: Calendar week rows extend as wide horizontal bands beneath the landscape header; a separate full-width notes horizon occupies the bottom.
weekly_shift: Seven daily horizontal lanes beneath the header, each containing shift name, start, end, break and handover fields. Team schedules add subrows rather than remove fields.
blank: Empty horizontal day/week lanes with writable date headings and no prefilled annual dates.

composition: A field-notebook aesthetic: black outline botanical details in two corners, small specimen-style labels, ruled cards and white writing areas. Keep decorative ink coverage low; any gray is purposeful and subordinate to the writing areas.
annual: Two six-month pages with specimen-style month cards, each including its own miniature calendar and a small optional observation line. All twelve months are present.
monthly: A ruled field-sheet: month grid on top and dated observation lines underneath; the decorative corners stay outside both.
weekly_shift: Seven labelled day cards, each with actual shift and handover fields. Cards flow across one or more pages while maintaining Monday–Sunday order.
blank: Empty observation cards and a blank day/date label on every card; the selected calendar/planner function still determines required fields.

composition: A functional dashboard with a calendar/schedule region, three priority boxes and a measurable task tracker. Small navy/amber section tabs guide use; no large ink-heavy fills.
annual: Four quarter pages, each showing its three full mini-months, quarterly goals, deadlines and review. Every month of the selected year is included exactly once.
monthly: A large monthly calendar plus goals, deadlines and a compact habit/task tracker. The tracker never overlaps date cells.
weekly_shift: Seven-day shift matrix with coverage totals, planned hours, breaks and a handover action list. Computed totals must state their inputs and policy.
blank: Undated functional grid plus empty priorities and tracking fields, with no date-sensitive values calculated until dates are supplied.

composition: A parallel-lane organizer with consistent person/project columns and a shared notes region. Teal/coral lane tabs differentiate roles while all meaning remains labelled in text.
annual: A yearly coordination matrix with twelve chronological month columns and editable person/project rows, plus a complete twelve-month date reference on companion page(s). A matrix alone does not count as a complete annual date calendar.
monthly: Days run down rows; people or projects run across columns. Each date is explicit; a shared notes/errands lane spans the bottom or side.
weekly_shift: People or roles run down rows and all seven days across columns. Optional second shift per day uses a distinct subcell with start/end fields; total and absence columns are explicit.
blank: Empty labelled lanes for people/projects and blank day/date rows, with editable headings and no invented team members.

composition: A practical black-on-white operational form: ruled tables, unfilled checkboxes, bold textual section labels, explicit totals and a handover area. No colored accents or decorative full-page fills; restrained gray can distinguish functional table regions.
annual: Three pages of four month grids, each accompanied by small labelled workday/holiday summary fields derived from verified data; one consolidated notes table follows.
monthly: A monthly operations table with date, weekday, task/shift, time and notes columns; rows for every real day and a clearly separated totals section.
weekly_shift: A full roster with staff/role, Monday–Sunday shifts, breaks, hours and coverage/handover fields. Preserve the original schedule data, overnight semantics and timezone.
blank: A genuinely empty reusable operational form, with blank date, names, shift and totals fields; do not print zeros as though a schedule were calculated.

composition: A modular card composition with interlocking corner tabs, bold geometric section markers and controlled blue/orange accents. Card dimensions are coordinated to a physical baseline grid.
annual: Twelve month cards in a 3 × 4 matrix, with quarter tabs connecting each group of three. A separate narrow annual milestones card completes the composition.
monthly: Week rows become connected rectangular modules, preserving seven ordered day cells; a distinct notes module sits below.
weekly_shift: Seven connected day modules, each containing labelled shift slots; team mode adds equally aligned person rows across every module.
blank: Empty modular day/week cards with writable headers and no dates; cards retain the required grid and slot count.

composition: Two large offset rectangular panels, a contrasting vertical index rail and one diagonal cut confined to the header. Writing areas and calendar grids remain orthogonal.
annual: Two half-year panels, each holding six months in a 3 × 2 grid, with a vertical year/quarter index between or beside the panels.
monthly: One dominant calendar panel and a smaller offset notes/deadlines panel, linked by the vertical month/week index.
weekly_shift: A wide seven-day shift panel and a separate offset coverage/handover panel. The diagonal header never cuts a cell or removes a weekday.
blank: Two empty working panels: the selected date/time grid and its notes/summary area, with all date labels writable.

composition: Black circular period badges paired with an orthogonal coordinate grid. Outlined circles, fine black ticks and whitespace provide emphasis; all information is also written as text.
annual: Four quarter quadrants around a small central year badge; each quadrant contains three months with an explicit chronological reading order. No dates are arranged around a decorative circle.
monthly: A circular month badge sits beside a full rectangular calendar. Small coordinate ticks label week rows; a rectangular notes area occupies the remaining width.
weekly_shift: The week number appears in a circle outside the roster; all seven day columns and staff rows remain rectangular, with a rectangular handover block below.
blank: An empty rectangular calendar or time grid with an unfilled period badge and writable labels.
